fullPassage: Nearly 200 years ago, Charles Darwin described the first time that he observed ocean water full of tiny bioluminescent organisms. He wrote that the sea was glowing with flickers of light. He also noted that the water still flashed with sparks of light after it was collected in a bottle. At the time, no one knew what caused the glow, but bioluminescence has been the subject of much research since then. Bioluminescence simply means light made by living things. Fireflies are a common example, but the phenomenon is found in some fish, mushrooms, bacteria, and other creatures as well. We now know that the light is made by chemicals called luciferins. The organisms light up when enzymes called luciferases interact with luciferin, and the varieties of luciferin in different creatures produce different colors of light. Humans have occasionally made use of bioluminescence in the past. Glowing fungus growing on wood may have been used to mark trails through forests and miners have used jars of fireflies to light their work underground. Unlike common light sources, bioluminescence produces almost no heat, so it is an attractive tool under many circumstances. Today, even more applications of bioluminescence are possible. For example, it is used to warn of toxic substances in water. Bioluminescent bacteria in water grow dimmer when toxic substances are present, alerting people to test for contamination from pesticides or heavy metals. In addition, inventors are trying to create eco-friendly lamps from algae that glow when the water they live in moves. These lamps are expected to reduce energy usage and light pollution. In medical research, firefly luciferase is mixed with a dye that causes it to emit near-infrared light, which can be detected through relatively thick layers of tissue. This mixture is used to mark blood clotting proteins, making it easier to monitor the effectiveness of blood thinners. Bioluminescence is older than the human species, but modern technology is giving it brand new uses. What was once a mysterious phenomenon is now helping us understand more about our bodies and the world around us, and hopefully allowing us to find ways to generate light with minimal environmental impact.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: help → helping: 'is now ______'은 현재진행형이라 -ing 형태인 helping으로 써야 해요.

① observed: 'the first time that he ______ ocean water'에서 다윈이 관찰했던 과거의 일이라 과거형 observed가 적절해요

③ expected: 'These lamps are ______ to reduce'에서 램프가 '기대되는' 것이라 수동태 expected가 적절해요

④ help: 'is now ______ us understand'는 현재진행형(is + -ing)이라 helping이 와야 해요. help는 틀려요 ←정답(틀린 곳)
det.tip: is now + -ing(helping) = 지금 ~하고 있다 (현재진행형).

det.korean: alerted → alerting: 앞 문장에 이미 동사 grow가 있으므로, 뒤는 '그래서 ~하게 한다'로 이어주는 분사 alerting으로 써야 해요.

det.korean: brighter(더 밝은) → dimmer(더 흐릿한): 독성 물질이 있으면 박테리아의 빛이 '약해져서' 오염을 알려주는 흐름이라 dimmer가 맞아요.
det.analysis:
① research(연구) — 생물발광이 많은 '연구'의 대상이 되어 왔다로 자연스러워요

② attractive(매력적인) — 열을 거의 내지 않아 여러 상황에서 '매력적인' 도구라로 자연스러워요

③ brighter(더 밝은) — 원문은 dimmer(더 흐릿한)예요. 독성 물질이 있을 때 박테리아 빛이 '약해지는' 변화로 오염을 경고하는 것이라, '더 밝아진다'는 반대예요 ←정답(부적절)

④ reduce(줄이다) — 친환경 램프가 에너지 사용과 빛 공해를 '줄일' 것으로 기대된다로 자연스러워요
det.tip: grow dimmer when toxic substances are present = 독성 물질 있으면 빛이 약해짐.

det.korean: maximum(최대의) → minimal(최소의): 글 전체가 친환경·저열의 장점을 말하므로, 환경에 미치는 영향은 '최소'여야 맞아요.
det.analysis:
① varieties(종류) — 서로 다른 '종류'의 루시페린이 다른 색을 낸다로 자연스러워요

② occasionally(가끔) — 인간이 과거에 생물발광을 '가끔' 이용했다로 자연스러워요

③ eco-friendly(친환경의) — 조류로 '친환경' 램프를 만든다로 자연스러워요

④ maximum(최대의) — 원문은 minimal(최소의)이에요. 열이 거의 없고 빛 공해를 줄이는 친환경 흐름이라, 환경에 미치는 영향은 '최소'여야 해요. '최대'는 반대예요 ←정답(부적절)
det.tip: generate light with minimal environmental impact = 환경 영향 최소로.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: intense heat=강한 열 / almost no heat=열이 거의 없음 / bright colors=밝은 색 / toxic gases=독성 기체
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞 'Unlike common light sources(흔한 광원과 달리)'와 뒤 'so it is an attractive tool(그래서 매력적인 도구다)'가 단서예요.

① intense heat(강한 열): 흔한 광원이 내는 것으로, '달리(unlike)'라는 대조와 안 맞아요

② almost no heat(열이 거의 없음): 흔한 광원과 '달리' 열을 거의 내지 않아 매력적인 도구예요 ←정답

③ bright colors(밝은 색): 열/도구 매력과 직접 연결되지 않아요

④ toxic gases(독성 기체): 매력적인 도구라는 긍정적 흐름과 반대예요
det.tip: Unlike common light sources ~, so it is an attractive tool → 열이 거의 없음(almost no heat).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: jars of fireflies=반딧불이가 든 병 / sticks of wood=나뭇가지 / pieces of metal=금속 조각 / cups of water=물 한 컵
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 'miners have used ______ to light their work underground(광부들이 지하 작업을 밝히는 데 ~을 썼다)'예요. 앞에서 빛나는 균류(나무 위)는 숲길 표시에 쓰였다고 했으니, 빛을 내는 또 다른 생물이 필요해요.

① jars of fireflies(반딧불이가 든 병): 열 없이 빛을 내는 반딧불이를 병에 담아 지하를 밝힐 수 있어요 ←정답

② sticks of wood(나뭇가지): 빛나는 균류는 '나무 위'에 있지만 그것은 숲길 표시용이에요

③ pieces of metal(금속 조각): 스스로 빛을 내지 못해요

④ cups of water(물 한 컵): 빛과 무관해요
det.tip: to light their work underground = 빛을 내는 생물 → 반딧불이가 든 병(jars of fireflies).

det.korean: 다윈은 바닷물을 병에 담은 뒤에도 물이 여전히 빛의 섬광으로 번쩍였다고 적었어요.

questions.passage: Nearly 200 years ago, Charles Darwin described the first time that he observed ocean water full of tiny bioluminescent organisms. He wrote that the sea was glowing with flickers of light. He also noted that the water still flashed with sparks of light after it was collected in a bottle. At the time, no one knew what caused the glow, but bioluminescence has been the subject of much research since then. Bioluminescence simply means light made by living things. Fireflies are a common example, but the phenomenon is found in some fish, mushrooms, bacteria, and other creatures as well. We now know that the light is made by chemicals called luciferins. The organisms light up when enzymes called luciferases interact with luciferin, and the varieties of luciferin in different creatures produce different colors of light. Humans have occasionally made use of bioluminescence in the past. Glowing fungus growing on wood may have been used to mark trails through forests and miners have used jars of fireflies to light their work underground. Unlike common light sources, bioluminescence produces almost no heat, so it is an attractive tool under many circumstances. Today, even more applications of bioluminescence are possible. For example, it is used to warn of toxic substances in water. Bioluminescent bacteria in water grow dimmer when toxic substances are present, alerting people to test for contamination from pesticides or heavy metals. In addition, inventors are trying to create eco-friendly lamps from algae that glow when the water they live in moves. These lamps are expected to reduce energy usage and light pollution. In medical research, firefly luciferase is mixed with a dye that causes it to emit near-infrared light, which can be detected through relatively thick layers of tissue. This mixture is used to mark blood clotting proteins, making it easier to monitor the effectiveness of blood thinners. Bioluminescence is older than the human species, but modern technology is giving it brand new uses. What was once a mysterious phenomenon is now helping us understand more about our bodies and the world around us, and hopefully allowing us to find ways to generate light with minimal environmental impact.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: '이용해 왔다'를 현재완료(have + 과거분사)로, 'make use of(~을 이용하다)' 표현을 살려 영작하는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
주어는 humans(인간)예요.

→ '이용해 왔다'는 현재완료 have made로 쓰되, 'make use of(~을 이용하다)' 숙어를 살려요.

→ 빈도부사 occasionally(가끔)는 have와 made 사이에 넣어요: have occasionally made.

→ 완성: humans have occasionally made use of bioluminescence
det.tip: have occasionally made use of ~ = ~을 가끔 이용해 왔다 (현재완료 + make use of).

questions.wa: humans have occasionally made use of bioluminescence
accept: humans have occasionally made use of bioluminescence

questions.passage: Firefly luciferase is mixed with a dye that causes it to emit near-infrared light. The light can be __________ (detect) through relatively thick layers of tissue.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: detect → detected: 'can be + __________'은 조동사 뒤 수동태라 과거분사 detected로 바꿔요.
det.analysis:
'The light can be __________ (detect) ~'에서 빛은 사람에게 '감지되는' 대상이에요.

→ 조동사 can 뒤에 'be + 과거분사'로 수동태를 만들어요. (can be + 과거분사 = ~될 수 있다)

→ 따라서 detect를 과거분사 detected로 바꿔요.
det.tip: can be + 과거분사(detected) = ~될 수 있다 (조동사 수동태).

questions.passage: Nearly 200 years ago, Charles Darwin described the first time that he observed ocean water full of tiny bioluminescent organisms. He wrote that the sea was glowing with flickers of light. He also noted that the water still flashed with sparks of light after it was collected in a bottle. At the time, no one knew what caused the glow, but bioluminescence has been the subject of much research since then. Bioluminescence simply means light made by living things. Fireflies are a common example, but the phenomenon is found in some fish, mushrooms, bacteria, and other creatures as well. We now know that the light is made by chemicals called luciferins. The organisms light up when enzymes called luciferases interact with luciferin, and __________. Humans have occasionally made use of bioluminescence in the past. Glowing fungus growing on wood may have been used to mark trails through forests and miners have used jars of fireflies to light their work underground. Unlike common light sources, bioluminescence produces almost no heat, so it is an attractive tool under many circumstances. Today, even more applications of bioluminescence are possible. For example, it is used to warn of toxic substances in water. Bioluminescent bacteria in water grow dimmer when toxic substances are present, alerting people to test for contamination from pesticides or heavy metals. In addition, inventors are trying to create eco-friendly lamps from algae that glow when the water they live in moves. These lamps are expected to reduce energy usage and light pollution. In medical research, firefly luciferase is mixed with a dye that causes it to emit near-infrared light, which can be detected through relatively thick layers of tissue. This mixture is used to mark blood clotting proteins, making it easier to monitor the effectiveness of blood thinners. Bioluminescence is older than the human species, but modern technology is giving it brand new uses. What was once a mysterious phenomenon is now helping us understand more about our bodies and the world around us, and hopefully allowing us to find ways to generate light with minimal environmental impact.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 (영어로) 쓰시오.

서로 다른 생물에 들어 있는 다양한 루시페린이 서로 다른 색의 빛을 만든다.
[조건] (1) colors, creatures, different, different, in, light, luciferin, of, of, produce, the, varieties 를 모두 사용 (2) 12단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 긴 주어(여러 수식어가 붙은 명사구)와 복수 주어-동사 일치를 다루는 영작이에요.
det.analysis:
주어의 핵심은 the varieties(다양한 종류)예요.

→ 'of luciferin in different creatures(서로 다른 생물에 든 루시페린의)'가 주어를 꾸며요: the varieties of luciferin in different creatures.

→ 주어의 핵심이 varieties(복수)라 동사는 -s 없는 produce로 써요.

→ 목적어는 different colors of light(서로 다른 색의 빛)로 마무리해요.

→ 완성: the varieties of luciferin in different creatures produce different colors of light
det.tip: 핵심 주어 varieties(복수) → produce (끼어든 luciferin에 속지 말 것).

questions.wa: the varieties of luciferin in different creatures produce different colors of light
accept: the varieties of luciferin in different creatures produce different colors of light

다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (영어로)

생물발광은 많은 연구의 대상이 되어 왔다.
[ research / been / subject / bioluminescence / much / has / the / of ] (8단어)

det.korean: '~의 대상이 되어 왔다'를 현재완료(has been)로 배열하는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
주어는 bioluminescence(생물발광)예요.

→ '되어 왔다'는 현재완료 has been으로 써요. (has been = 지금까지 ~이어 왔다)

→ 'the subject of much research(많은 연구의 대상)'를 보어로 이어요.

→ 완성: bioluminescence has been the subject of much research
det.tip: has been the subject of ~ = ~의 대상이 되어 왔다 (현재완료).

questions.wa: bioluminescence has been the subject of much research
accept: bioluminescence has been the subject of much research

다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]의 단어를 모두 사용하여 (영어로) 쓰시오.

그것은 물속의 독성 물질을 경고하는 데 쓰인다.
[조건] (1) in, is, it, of, substances, to, toxic, used, warn, water 를 모두 사용 (2) 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '~하는 데 쓰인다'를 'be used to + 동사원형'(수동태)으로 영작하는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
주어는 it(그것)이에요.

→ '쓰인다'는 수동태 is used로 써요.

→ '경고하는 데'는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 to warn으로 이어요. ('be used to + 동사원형' = ~하는 데 쓰이다)

→ 'warn of(~을 경고하다)' 뒤에 toxic substances in water(물속의 독성 물질)를 붙여요.

→ 완성: it is used to warn of toxic substances in water
det.tip: be used to + 동사원형(warn) = ~하는 데 쓰이다 (습관의 used to와 구별).

questions.wa: it is used to warn of toxic substances in water
accept: it is used to warn of toxic substances in water
